auth.register.description: Ƙirƙiri amintaccen walat ɗin wucewa tare da na'urarka. Babu ilimin crypto da ake buƙata.
auth.register.biometricPrompt: Burauzar ku zai nemi tabbaci na biometric
auth.register.securityNote: An kiyaye walat ɗin ku ta hanyar na'urar nazarin halittu. Babu maɓallan sirri da ke barin na'urarka.
auth.sign.title: Ƙirƙiri asusun ku
auth.sign.description: Yi nazarin bayanan ku kuma tabbatar
auth.sign.terms: Ta ci gaba, kun yarda da mu
auth.sign.cooldown: Ƙoƙari da yawa. A sake gwadawa a ciki
auth.login.signInDescription: Yi amfani da maþallin maɓalli don samun damar asusunku amintacce.
auth.login.noPasskey: Ba a sami maballin wucewa akan wannan na'urar.
landing.heroDesc: Da'irar ajiyar kuɗi ta karkata akan Stellar. Masu tsaka-tsaki babu. ikon mallakar kuɗi na biliyan 1.3 mara banki.
landing.feat1Desc: Kwangiloli masu wayo suna tilasta kowane doka. Babu mai shiryawa da zai iya gudu tare da tafkin. An tabbatar da kowace gudunmawa ta kan sarkar.
landing.feat2Desc: Duk wanda ke da walat ɗin Stellar. Babu asusun banki. Babu rajistan kiredit. Babu iyaka.
landing.feat3Desc: Gina MoiScore tare da kowace gudummawar kan lokaci. Asalin kuɗi mai ɗaukar nauyi.
landing.feat4Desc: Ma'amaloli na Stellar suna sa da'irar yau da kullun ta zama mai amfani. Babu kuɗin dandamali don ƙirƙira ko haɗawa.
landing.feat5Desc: Bazuwar, kafaffen, gwanjo, ko zabe. Da'irar ku, dokokin ku.
landing.feat6Desc: USDC yau. Ƙarin stablecoins akan taswirar hanya.
landing.readyDesc: Ƙirƙiri da'irar ajiyar ku ta farko a cikin ƙasa da mintuna biyu.
error.tryAgain: Da fatan za a sake gwadawa
